name: livemira
description: LiveMira engine source: browser image-target AR with an embedded Worker, WebAssembly and WebGPU shaders.
author: Andy (@andy-mira)

scripts.build: npm run version:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node apps/demo/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/release/build-engine-single.mjs && node scripts/release/build-target-quality.mjs && node scripts/release/build-tracking-visuals.mjs && node scripts/release/build-recognition-diagnostics.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-isolation=none packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs packages/sdk/test/*.test.mjs tests/reliability/bilingual-documentation.test.mjs tests/reliability/release-metadata.test.mjs tests/quality/standalone.test.mjs tests/reliability/engine-single.test.mjs tests/reliability/tracking-visuals-standalone.test.mjs tests/reliability/recognition-diagnostics-standalone.test.mjs
